judgment: The v2 escaped-child blocker is materially reduced: under the same fixed native Seatbelt policy, both no-credential fork-then-setsid and posix_spawn paths fail with EPERM before a child exists; the exact bundled Mihomo mock-node -t fixture returns rc0. The policy is a macOS process restriction, not an OCI container, image or namespace. This supports one exact root-released local credential-bearing syntax check, with the existing process-group cleanup retained as a second gate.
limits: These negative probes do not formally prove every possible process creation API is denied. The fixture label sandbox_descendant_denied is an inherited test name: in v3 its nested subprocess is stopped at process creation and does not independently prove descendant network behavior.
Real selected-node -t rc and its attempted network behavior remain UNKNOWN. Seatbelt no-network policy is intended to deny egress; only local no-credential probes were observed.
Success here is not proxy listener, gz02 authentication, native graph, HelloWorld or device acceptance.
Forced SIGKILL or host loss can leave the private 0600 credential directory, requiring nonce-based manual audit and exact cleanup.
next_release: Root may separately issue the exact fixed v3 root release for one local sandboxed mihomo -t check only, after confirming current source/binary hashes and no START. No replay. v2b proxy listener and v2c SSH need separate review and release.
